requirementSummary: Calculate and display the DX Coil Height by summing the heights of all populated Cooling Circuits, and automatically update this total when any Circuit Height is edited.
businessRules: When a Cooling Package is entered, the system must populate the Cooling Circuits.
The DX Coil Height field must be set to the sum of the heights of all populated circuits.
If a user modifies the height of any circuit, the DX Coil Height must be recalculated and updated immediately.
developerConsiderations: Implement event listeners or data binding to detect changes to individual circuit height fields.
Ensure the initial DX Coil Height field is empty and populated only after circuit data is loaded and summed.
Handle numeric validation for circuit heights (e.g., positive numbers, appropriate unit consistency).
Optimize UI performance for real‑time recalculation as users edit values.
ambiguities: The source and format of the initial Cooling Circuit data are not specified.
Units of measurement for heights are not defined.
No validation rules are described for acceptable height values (range, precision).
Behavior when circuits are added or removed after initial load is unclear.
